notes: Cold run 9041's frames showed every facade as pale cells on a dark matrix -- pebbledash, on 187 of 236 slots of that shell. The cause was `edges` at 9 cells / 0.70 / 0.35, a crack NET rather than a few cracks, exactly the mistake the asphalt had (roadmap 45). Concrete is a warm grey panel: sand in the face at 120 cells, the macro band carrying the staining a wall gets from its own roof, three cracks instead of ninety, and a warp so the staining does not run true. REFUTED AND CORRECTED: `thr` thins a crack, it never removes one -- F2-F1 is a closed tessellation -- so 0.96 was still crazy paving at 67 cm. `sparsity` 0.22 keeps about a fifth of the net, which is a few cracks that begin and end. AND THE CRACKS CAME OUT ALTOGETHER. Sparsity works by keeping a FRACTION of the net, so at 0.12 on a 2 m tile the survivors are one recognisable clump, and a 2 m tile crossing a 30 m wall repeats it fifteen times in a lattice. An isolated feature in a tiling texture advertises the tile; cracks on a wall belong in an insert layer, which is what the Bloodborne reference calls tileables plus inserts (docs/SET_DRESSING_REFERENCES.md). Sparsity stays on the asphalt, where 0.30 leaves dozens of fragments per tile and no motif.
